title: King of Invokations
description: While in Sumeru, you bump into a novelist looking for inspiration.

mainQuestExcel.description: While in Sumeru, you bump into a novelist looking for inspiration.

dialogs.text: Traveler! Nice to see you again. Thanks to your help last time, Asagiri went smoothly with her illustrations.
Glad I could help.
Yes, the researchers are still going over the finer details of production at the Akademiya.
Some have said that, since it's a new edition, the resource system should be innovative to ensure an experience that encourages creativity.
Some said more budget should be spent on hiring artists as attractive card designs are crucial to the card game.
And someone went even further, expecting a battle among all the researchers involved in the creation of Genius Invokation TCG.
The winner gets a greater say in it. Well, I think it's just their excuse for playing Genius Invokation TCG.
I could hardly understand anything that they were talking about, so I left saying I needed some inspiration.
Could you model for me again, Traveler?
I'm not asking for anything special this time. Just a quick showcase of your battle skills will do.
I thought you were writing a card game novel?
Well, just so you know, there's not much of a market for plain card games now.
Honestly, I think fighting in a card game is getting a bit tacky. I'm now devising a plot where my characters play cards while racing on horses.
But I haven't decided on the reason they do that... So I guess I'll start with the scene where they turn a card game into a fight.
I've found a nice spot for the setting. Let's get going then.
What does card game have to do with battle skills?
Are you still looking for inspiration today?
Traveler! Nice to see you again. Thanks to your help last time, Asagiri went smoothly with her illustrations.
Glad I could help.
That's right. To novelists like me, more material could never hurt!
Sumeru is such an interesting place as well — I can't say I lack for new things to see, even now.
If it wasn't for Asagiri's fragile constitution, I would have asked her to come to Sumeru to gather inspiration as well.
Ahem. Anyway, let's talk business... Could you model for me again, Traveler?
I'm not asking for anything special this time. Just a quick showcase of your battle skills will do.
Aren't you writing a card game novel?
Well, just so you know, there's not much of a market for plain card games now.
Honestly, even I think that fighting via card games is getting a bit tacky by this point. I'm now devising a plot where my characters play cards while racing on horses!
But I haven't decided on the reason why they might even do that in the first place... So I guess I'll just have to start with a scene where a card game turns into a battle.
I've found a nice spot for the setting. Let's get going then.
What do card games have to do with battle skills?
Are you here to look for inspiration today as well?

dialogs.text: This is the place! Look, there's a handful of Slimes over there.
Traveler, please beat them in the way you think is the most impressive!
Are you sure it'll be applied in the card game novel?
Of course! It's true that playing cards can fix most of the problems in my novel.
But there will always be things that cannot be solved by playing cards, and the characters will need to rely on some "realistic" tactics.
I'm counting on you, Traveler. I'll be waiting here.
Excellent! This picture must be enough for Asagiri to draw a few more.
I want to play Genius Invokation TCG.
Hahaha... I'll convey this to the researchers.
But the researchers' work seems to be going so well that they can now make light of their discussions.
Unlike at the very beginning, well... when they argued for days on end...
I'm excited about Genius Invokation TCG.
Excellent! This picture must be enough for Asagiri to draw a few more.
Thank you, Traveler. Please, take these as your reward.
Once I finish my work... Well, perhaps we can have a little "duel" then!
Darn it. Those Sumeru people made me feel so cheated!
Did someone cheat you out of your money?
Wah, you... you scared me!
*sigh* I didn't lose money, but they did trick me into coming to Sumeru...
Oh, let me introduce myself first... My name is Fukumoto, a novelist from Inazuma.
You say you were cheated?
Well, it's a long story... Have you heard of Genius Invokation, the card game created by the Akademiya?
G—Genius Invokation?
You didn't know that? I'm surprised. Haven't you heard of that book I wrote, "King of Invokations"? It's one of the best sellers in Yae Publishing House!
Uh... you didn't know that either? It's... It's alright. It doesn't matter!
In short, some guys in the Sumeru Akademiya invented a card game named Genius Invokation TCG.
To promote the game, they asked me through Yae Publishing House to write a light novel based on its rules.

However, those researchers haven't figured out the game rules themselves. Besides, our communication is far from efficient given the long distance between Sumeru and Inazuma. So I've been having a tough time writing...
Fortunately, I got to finish the novel with the support of Yae Publishing House. The book sold well, and it drove the sales of Genius Invokation TCG as planned.
And here's the point... the researchers said they would rewrite the rules for Genius Invokation TCG and roll out a new version of the game.
They asked me to write a sequel based on the new game, and invited me to the Sumeru Akademiya for a face-to-face meeting.

I came all the way from Inazuma to Sumeru, only to hear from the researchers that... the rules of the new version of Genius Invokation TCG have yet to be determined! They have asked me to stay in Sumeru for the time being.
They meant to apologize, and introduce me to some big names in the Akademiya as the inspirations for my book, including Cyno, and Tighnari...

At first I was a little upset, but the researchers... every one of them looked like they hadn't gotten a single night's sleep in a long time. The one who was supposed to greet me could barely stand...

*sigh* So I gave it some thought. Since I haven't even finished working on the outline for my book, I should be able to wait a little longer. I agreed to stay in Sumeru until the new rules are finalized.
Thus, this is what I've come for today.
Traveler, could you do me a favor?
Only if you tell me what it is...
Here's the thing. To make the novel more appealing, I went out of my way and asked Asagiri to draw illustrations for it.
I've decided on several key plots for illustrations. But in addition to written descriptions, I also need to give Asagiri some pose references.
But with my limited experience in fighting, the poses I struck all looked weak and lacked spirit.
Traveler, I bet you're a battle-hardened veteran. Can you model for me? See, I even borrowed a Kamera...
Alright...
I appreciate that, Traveler. I've found a nice spot. Let's head there!
Make sure I look good.
No problem. Trust me on that!
I'm not very good at playing cards...
Card game?
*sigh* Are these researchers actually okay?
What's wrong with the researchers?

*sigh* Don't get me started. It's about Genius Invokation TCG, of course. Judging from how hard the researchers are working, I'm worried that they'll have ground themselves to dust by the time the new rules are finished.
Still, they seem to have worked out the general idea for the rules of the game. I finally have something to work with.
I don't quite understand the nature of their work... All I can do is trust that they'll do their best.
As for me? I've still got some work to do on the illustrations.
Thanks to your help last time, Asagiri has produced some pretty nice illustrations.
If you don't mind, Traveler, could you be my model again?
Alright...
Thanks a lot. I will take care of the payment.
I've found a nice spot. It's not far away.
Alright, lemme pack up my Kamera and then we can head out!
Didn't they introduce you to any big names?
Well... they said they were trying, but it seems that Cyno and Tighnari are too busy to model for now.
But I heard Cyno is a master in Genius Invokation TCG!
If I can get him to strike a dashing pose at the table with cards in hand...
Forget it. We'd better be realistic.
Thank you for being my model, Traveler. I'll be sure to compensate you!

Well, it's not like I get to visit Sumeru whenever I want. Of course, I gotta make the most of my stay here.
Which, by the way, can also give me a break from my editor... Ahem!

When will you return to Inazuma?
Hmm... Once I get enough inspiration.
So much good writing material. I want to write a little more.

dialogs.text: This is the place. Let me see... Well, first I need...
A pose when the character finds themselves in trouble...
That's not clear at all. Paimon has no idea what kind of pose to make!
Umm... Just go with your instinct.
Now Traveler, what will you do when you find yourself in trouble?
Well, I'll fight.
Impressive answer! So the first thing you do in the face of trouble is to fight... then please strike an imposing fighting stance!
Just like... you are ready to fight against the difficulties ahead.
This fight is what it takes to survive! Your only choice to live!
Ahem! Actually, these are the lines I designed for my character... Anyway, just try to imagine the situation and pose.
Umm... Paimon doubts the character would actually say things like that...
I won't get myself into trouble.
What a proud answer! Just like one of my characters!
Then please strike a proud pose!

flow.stepDescription: Go to the spot and strike a pose
